name: Hammerhead-class cruiser
description: The Hammerhead-class cruiser was a type of warship used by the Republic Navy during the Old Sith Wars, the Mandalorian Wars, and the New Sith Wars. One of the most successful warship designs in galactic history, the Hammerhead-class still saw use in sector defense forces millennia after its introduction and inspired many other ship designs, such as the Thranta-class corvette and MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser.
